items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: he, Bergerér, I think he managed to get -- he went to the States... His name was Arthur Briggs

ctx.x: Privado Butter Company in France, and during the conversation he had with someone, they mentioned that they had seen at the Chez Florence Cabaret in Paris after liberation, because he, Bergerér, I think he managed to get -- he went to the States, he managed to get to New York before the Germans came in. And he said --'Chez Florence, I had a very good friend, I know he was at Chez Florence from 1946 on. His name was Arthur
